# Denied commit identities (CLAUDE.md "Commit Messages").
#
# One lowercase entry per line: an exact email address, or @domain for every
# address in that domain. A denied identity is rejected as a commit author
# or co-author even when the base history ratifies it. CI reads this file
# from the base branch, so a pull request cannot remove its own block.
#
# AI tool identities (an AI co-author put an account in the GitHub
# contributors graph; see PR #657).
